note: After the optimization track: stemmer refactor, query-embedding LRU cache, ef-gather knob, parallel lexical rebuild, two-tier index/graph deferral, raw contiguous vector block, vector sharing. Same host as baseline. In-process keyword embedder (no Ollama), see rag/speed_test.go and rag/retrieve_bench_test.go. delta_ns_pct = (after-before)/before*100, positive means slower. Retrieve and RetrieveGraph are reported from a second, longer run (benchtime=500x); their first-run deltas (1.5% and 4.6%) were run-to-run jitter and the 500x run shows parity within noise. Dotf kernels were not touched by the track; their small deltas are CPU clock noise. The similarity-graph PPR path was measured with a parallel worker implementation and reverted to the serial algorithm, which was ~50% faster at 3000 nodes with ~9x fewer allocations; the pool-reuse of the two PPR buffers is kept.
